Navigation

Chặng vào

The segment of a holding pattern or approach procedure flown toward the fix or navigation aid, typically timed or distance-limited.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Chặng vào?

In this glossary, Chặng vào refers to: The segment of a holding pattern or approach procedure flown toward the fix or navigation aid, typically timed or distance-limited.

How is Chặng vào used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Duy trì 180 knot trên chặng vào của vùng chờ tại điểm SODRI."

Why does Chặng vào matter in aviation?

Chặng vào matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

The segment of a holding pattern or approach procedure flown toward the fix or navigation aid, typically timed or distance-limited.

Operational example

Maintain 180 knots on the inbound leg of the holding at waypoint SODRI.
